name: SQA3D
description: SQA3D is a benchmark for situated question answering in 3D scenes, requiring agents to understand their position and orientation in a 3D environment and reason about their surroundings to answer diverse questions. It contains 650 scenes from ScanNet, 6.8k unique situations, 20.4k descriptions, and 33.4k reasoning questions covering spatial relations, commonsense, navigation, and multi-hop reasoning.
reputation: Highlights significant challenge to current multi-modal and 3D reasoning models; human performance much higher than SOTA
notes: Focuses on situated understanding and reasoning in 3D scenes; includes a wide spectrum of reasoning capabilities
